purpose_context: Part of the whole-pack round trip (epic #186, issue #195). The files that describe a pack as a whole - its activation presets, its Markdown description, its authored descriptor and its generated manifest - are loaded into the charter domain through deliberately designed, closed storage shapes and written back, so the whole-pack round-trip gate covers them and pack authors can rely on the service not to lose, invent or silently tolerate content at the pack level.
purpose_tldr: Read every pack-level file of a Charter Pack (presets, pack.md, pack.yaml, pack-manifest.yaml) into the domain in a sanitized shape and write it back without loss of meaning.
